Shows the new features the first time the Zeus interface is opened after Zeus Enhanced is updated.\nAll features can be browsed from the pause menu under Options.
Leave notes in the world for yourself and other curators. Mark objectives, explain a setup, or point out something to keep an eye on.
Placing Comments

Right-click to open the context menu and choose Place Comment.

Give it a title, an optional tooltip with more detail, and a color that stands out. Each comment shows the name of the Zeus who placed it.
Editing Comments
Interact with a comment through its icon:
Move the comment.
Edit the comment's properties.
Delete the hovered comment.
Comments are shared and synchronized with every Zeus, so all curators see the same notes, including ones who join later.
3DEN Comments

Comments placed in the 3DEN Editor appear in Zeus automatically, in their own color. They cannot be moved and can only be deleted if allowed in Addon Options. To keep one hidden, uncheck Show Comment in Zeus in 3DEN.
Save a group of objects and quickly select or navigate to them again. Use the bar at the bottom to reference and interact with your presets.
Saving Presets
Select some objects, then click in the bar to save them to the next empty slot. To save to a specific slot or change an existing preset, use these shortcuts:
Save the selection to that slot.
Replace a preset with the selection.
Add the selection to an existing preset.
Selecting Presets
Select the objects of a saved preset by clicking it in the bar or using the shortcuts. For reference:
Select a preset.
Select the preset in that slot.
Hover over a preset to see a list of the objects that it contains.
Customizing the Bar
Make the bar your own from {esc} > Options > Addon Options, under Zeus Enhanced > Selection Presets. You can:
Show empty slots, hide them, or replace them with an add button.
Show units with their group's icon.
Hide the tooltips that list a preset's contents.
Exclude props and modules automatically from new presets.
Disable the bar entirely, while keeping the keyboard shortcuts.
Presets are now persistent. Unlike in vanilla Zeus, your presets are saved when you close the interface, and restored when you return to Zeus after, for example, remote controlling a unit.
